name: Bharat Global Developers Limited
about: Bharat Global Developers Limited engages in wholesale and trading of gold. The company is also involved in trading of construction materials, agricultural products and textiles, etc. In addition, it provides green energy, engineering and infrastructure, aerospace and defence, agriculture, and waste management solutions. Further, the company is involved in electronics, consultancy and allied activities. The company was formerly known as KKRRAFTON Developers Limited and changed its name to Bharat Global Developers Limited in August 2024. Bharat Global Developers Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
